clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshore, Highborne Relics remain in the hands of spirits haunting Ameth'Aran. Night elf scholars seek them for destruction before their dormant magic can cause more harm.

Ten thousand years ago, the Highborne caste brought ruin upon ancient Kalimdor through reckless arcane magic. Their estates lie in shattered ruins across Darkshore. At Ameth'Aran, wailing apparitions wander among the crumbling columns, still clutching the implements of their old sorcery. The relics bind arcane taint to the spirits, who will not release the objects tied to their undoing.

Night elf society largely renounced arcane magic after the Great Sundering, and scholars see these relics as a grave hazard. Acting on reports from the Sentinels, Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine sends travelers to wrest them from the cursed spirits. Once gathered, the relics are destroyed so the Highborne's ancient evils and catastrophic mistakes cannot be repeated.
